requirements.rule: APPRENTICESHIP: 2022 CCNL Art. 3d changed system from sotto-inquadramento to percentage ('calcolate in percentuale...come da allegata tabella'). Pre-2022 system confirmed from full CCNL 2008 text (integrating Accordo 15/03/2006): 2 levels below destination for first half of apprenticeship, 1 level below for second half, no seniority increments accrued. Post-2022 percentage values from scanned allegata tabella not extractable (OCR-confirmed: image-only PDF). 2025-2028 rinnovo (12-page OCR) does not modify apprenticeship. Modelled as 1.00 passthrough pending actual 2022+ percentage values.
requirements.remediation: Extract the post-2022 percentage table and model the percentage track.

requirements.rule: A percentage apprenticeship reduces every fixed allowance whose apprenticeship_pct_relevant flag the data leaves at its default, together with the base salary. Whether the CCNL applies the percentage to that allowance (an EDR, a contingenza, a function allowance) was not sourced. The run is affected when such an allowance is in the apprentice's pay.
requirements.remediation: Source, for each CCNL, the elements the apprenticeship percentage applies to and set apprenticeship_pct_relevant on every allowance; the limitation then no longer applies to its runs.

requirements.rule: DIVISORS: hourly 174 (art. 10 c. 1, p. 21). The 1/25 is the quota of a holiday on a Sunday or the compensatory rest day (art. 18, p. 26), in work_rules.sunday_holidays; the CCNL states no general daily divisor for the absences, which keep the unverified by_26.
requirements.remediation: Find the daily quota of an unpaid absence of the CCNL (or of the payroll practice of the sector) and set work_rules.absence_rules.daily_divisor_method.

requirements.rule: SICKNESS PAY ACROSS EPISODES (artt. 72, 84, 95): 100% for 180 days and 50% for 180 more of each episode, within a total of 180 + 180 days over 18 months for several episodes, the count starting again after five months of effective work; the engine counts the bands per episode, so several episodes may be overpaid.
requirements.remediation: Cap the pay bands of several episodes at 180 + 180 days in 18 months and reset them after five months of work.
